verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a plausible feature for a SaaS identity-verification platform's dashboard, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack shows one. The no-code Workflow Studio is a drag-and-drop builder, and llms.txt is documentation formatted for external LLMs; neither is an in-product assistant you can delegate tasks to.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
